question: Now that Stage 1 is human-accepted and complete, should Stage 2 be activated to implement the frozen HarnessTask contract, complete the explicitly deferred implementation hardening, preserve mixed-format compatibility, and then prepare exactly one first-file migration packet for separate human disposition?

options.summary: Activate Stage 2 exactly under the accepted contract.
options.consequence: Activate only harness.simplification.docs-json.task-document-migration. Implement the accepted project-local contract and Stage-2 hardening obligations without changing accepted public fields, signatures, ownership, or wire behavior; preserve mixed Markdown/JSON inspection; then prepare exactly one first-file packet and stop for its human disposition. Accept no file migration automatically.

options.summary: Revise the Stage-2 implementation Task before activation.
options.consequence: Keep Stage 2 inactive, apply only the requested control or implementation-plan correction, and return for renewed activation review without implementation or migration.
Keep the accepted Stage-1 contract and six Markdown sources unchanged, leave Stage 2 inactive, and perform no implementation or migration.

recommendation: Option A only if implementation should begin now. Stage 1 is complete, the accepted contract is frozen, exact PIHL.TASK codes and precedence, template parsing, comparator algorithms, schema fixtures, ResourcePath rejection cases, and hardening tests are explicitly Stage-2 obligations, and every file migration still requires its own later human disposition.
blocked_scope: Stage-2 activation; all public-interface, serializer, deserializer, graph-validator, renderer, comparator, packet, recorder, schema, fixture, test, adapter, inspection, and documentation implementation; any first-file packet; every file migration or disposition; projection-drift synchronization; material contract change; selection-state work; chain cutover; successor activation; dependency, lockfile, SQLite, telemetry, scientific, publication, external, protected, or release work.
safe_scope: Human review of the accepted Stage-1 contract and acceptance checkpoint, Stage-2 Task and intake, maintained review pages, this checkpoint, and the unchanged six source files. Deterministic validation and persistence of this pending activation boundary are permitted.
authorized_scope: Revise only the inactive Stage-2 control and documentation plan into separately activated Stage 2A HarnessTask implementation/hardening and Stage 2B serial six-file migration Tasks, preserve the accepted Stage-1 contract, add the specified concise implementation-acceptance packet and per-file before/after review boundaries, create one renewed Stage-2A activation checkpoint, and perform no implementation, migration, SQLite, selection-state, chain cutover, or unrelated work.
